poll.source_locator: Press release Table 1/Table 2, October 2026 rows: Absolutely certain + already voted (= 'likely voters'): Tiffany 44, Crowley 51, Haven't decided 4. 'The survey was conducted Oct. 14-22, 2026, interviewing 818 Wisconsin registered voters ... For likely voters, the sample size is 668'
poll.notes: MLSP92 wave, final pre-election Marquette Wisconsin survey. MoE +/-4.7. Hybrid sample: 613 voter-registration list + 205 SSRS Opinion Panel; 747 online, 71 live phone. LV = absolutely certain to vote or already voted. Sum 99 (rounding). Recall weighting left UNVERIFIED for the same reason as MLSP91: headline weight's calibration list has no presidential-vote margin, a second weight adds recalled 2024 vote, and the release does not say which weight produced the toplines.

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was calibrated to registered voter benchmarks by age (18-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+); education (...); sex (male, female) by marital status (married, unmarried); leaned self-reported Party ID (Republican/Lean Republican, No lean, Democrat/Lean Democrat); WI region (...) by L2-modeled Party ID (Republican, Other, Democrat); and 2024 vote mode (did not vote, voted early, voter on Election Day) by L2-modeled Party ID. ... A second weight was computed by following all previous steps, plus an additional calibration margin for recalled 2024 presidential vote.
pollster.mode: hybrid: online (747) + live-interviewer telephone (71); L2 voter-list RBS (613) + SSRS Opinion Panel (205)
pollster.method_locator: MLSP92Methodology.pdf, 'WEIGHTING' section, 'Calibration' subsection (ellipses mark category lists omitted); p.1 summary: 'weighted to reflect demographic benchmarks of Wisconsin registered voters, the 2020 presidential election result and partisanship'
